review_candidates.title: Digital Marketing & Graphic Design Specialist
review_candidates.description: About the Role Saudi Executive Co., a leading Saudi technology company specializing in GPS Tracking, Fleet Management, IoT, and Smart Mobility Solutions, is seeking a highly creative and skilled Digital Marketing & Graphic Design Specialist based in Egypt for a full-time remote position. We are looking for a hands-on professional to take full ownership of our social media accounts, graphic design, digital content, corporate branding, marketing materials, business presentations, and market research activities. The ideal candidate must be capable of independently creating high-quality marketing and commercial materials, supporting business development initiatives, and maintaining a premium, consistent, and professional corporate image across all digital and business communication channels. Key Responsibilities 1. Social Media Management Fully manage LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. Develop and execute monthly social media content calendars. Create, design, schedule, and publish engaging content. Monitor engagement, messages, and account performance. Develop creative strategies to strengthen brand awareness and digital engagement. 2. Graphic Design & Corporate Branding Design high-quality social media posts, advertisements, banners, and promotional materials. Create professional company profiles, brochures, catalogs, and corporate presentations. Develop and maintain professional corporate templates and branded documents. Maintain and enhance the company's visual identity. Ensure brand consistency across all marketing, sales, and communication channels. 3. Business Presentations, Quotations & Sales Materials Design professional quotations, commercial proposals, and sales presentations using approved commercial information. Create visually appealing PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks, and business proposals. Design product and service offering documents, pricing tables, and promotional packages. Develop professional templates for quotations, proposals, and customer-facing documents. Prepare marketing presentations and sales materials for corporate clients, meetings, and business opportunities. Collaborate with sales and management teams to transform technical and commercial information into clear, attractive, and professional presentations. 4. Content Creation & Video Editing Write compelling marketing content in Arabic and English. Create promotional videos, Reels, animations, and motion graphics. Edit product demonstrations and corporate videos using supplied footage and assets. Develop creative visual concepts for products, services, and campaigns. Produce professional visual content highlighting company achievements, products, and solutions. 5. Digital Marketing & Advertising Plan and manage digital marketing campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, and Meta. Develop targeted B2B marketing content and campaigns. Coordinate with sales teams to support lead generation. Create promotional offers, marketing campaigns, and product launch materials. Monitor campaign results and optimize performance. 6. Market Research & Competitive Analysis Conduct market research covering Saudi Arabia's technology, GPS Tracking, Fleet Management, IoT, and Smart Mobility sectors. Research competitors, products, services, pricing trends, and market positioning. Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and emerging industry trends. Analyze competitors' marketing strategies, digital presence, and promotional activities. Prepare market research reports, competitor comparisons, and business insights. Provide actionable recommendations to support marketing strategies, product positioning, and business development. 7. Brand Presence & Marketing Support Maintain an outstanding and professional digital and corporate presence for Saudi Executive Co. Coordinate website content updates. Develop marketing materials for product launches, events, exhibitions, and corporate announcements. Create professional sales presentations, marketing offers, and digital marketing assets. Support management and sales teams with creative and professional business communication materials. Monitor competitors and propose innovative marketing ideas. 8. Reporting & Performance Prepare monthly digital marketing and market research reports. Track engagement, reach, audience growth, and campaign effectiveness. Evaluate marketing activities and identify opportunities for improvement. Continuously recommend improvements to brand visibility, corporate presentation, and marketing performance. Requirements Minimum 3 years of proven experience in digital marketing, graphic design, and corporate marketing materials. Advanced skills in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and professional business presentation design. Proven ability to design quotations, commercial proposals, company profiles, and marketing presentations. Strong video editing skills using Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent tools. Excellent Arabic and English content creation skills. Proven experience managing corporate social media accounts. Solid understanding of digital advertising and B2B marketing. Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, and prepare professional business reports. Strong creativity, attention to detail, and visual design skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities. Experience in technology, telecommunications, IoT, or B2B companies is preferred. Must be based in Egypt and available for full-time remote work. Ability to collaborate effectively with a Saudi Arabia-based team. How to Apply Please submit your application through LinkedIn, including: Updated CV. Professional Design Portfolio (Mandatory). Samples of corporate presentations, quotations, commercial proposals, and marketing materials you have personally designed. Examples of social media accounts, campaigns, and videos you have personally created or managed. Examples of market research or competitor analysis reports, if available. Applications without a portfolio demonstrating actual design, presentation, and content creation capabilities may not be considered. Saudi Executive Co. | Smart Solutions CONNECTING OPERATIONS. DRIVING PERFORMANCE.
